alter PROC [OM].[SP_UPDATE_PROCESS_DATE_LOANS] AS

BEGIN

		DECLARE @FLAG_SUCC_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @FLAG_TASK_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		DECLARE @NEXT_PROCESS_DATE [datetime]
		DECLARE @FLAG_INIT_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
		
		SELECT 
			@FLAG_INIT_CNT=COUNT(*)				
		FROM 
			(SELECT TOP 1 TASK_NAME FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME like '%LOANS%') OTR
		
		SELECT 
			@FLAG_SUCC_CNT=COUNT(*),
			@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE=MAX(DD.FULLDATE)
		FROM 
			EDS.EDS_CTL EC
		INNER JOIN
			EDS.DATE_DIM DD
			ON
			EC.LOANS_DATE=DD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
			AND 
            DD.business_day_flag = 'Y'
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
			ON
			DD.FULLDATE=OTR.PROCESS_DATE
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_TASKS OT
			ON
			OT.TASK_NAME=OTR.TASK_NAME
			AND OT.SOURCE_CODE='LNS'
		INNER JOIN
			OM.OM_STATUS OS
			ON
			OS.STATUS_ID=OTR.STATUS_ID
		WHERE
			OS.STATUS='SUCCESSFUL'
			AND OT.TASK_NAME in ('TSK_EDS_LNS_HISTTRANDTL','TSK_EDS_LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN','TSK_EDS_LNS_LAREPSHDL','TSK_EDS_LNS_LAACCTMAST','TSK_EDS_LOANS_FACT')
		
		SELECT 
			@FLAG_TASK_CNT=COUNT(*) 
		FROM 
			OM.OM_TASKS OT
		WHERE
			OT.SOURCE_CODE='LNS'
			AND OT.TASK_NAME in ('TSK_EDS_LNS_HISTTRANDTL','TSK_EDS_LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN','TSK_EDS_LNS_LAREPSHDL','TSK_EDS_LNS_LAACCTMAST','TSK_EDS_LOANS_FACT')
	

		IF(@FLAG_SUCC_CNT<>@FLAG_TASK_CNT AND @FLAG_INIT_CNT>0)
			BEGIN
				--RAISERROR('CURRENT BUSINESS DATE STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR ALL LOANS JOBS. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 16,1)
				THROW 50001, 'CURRENT BUSINESS DATE STATUS IS NOT YET SUCCESSFUL FOR ALL LOANS JOBS. PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 1;
			END
			
		IF(@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE IS NULL)
			BEGIN
				--RAISERROR('NO NEXT BUSINESS DATE RETRIEVED FROM EDS.DATE_DIM, OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 16,1)
				THROW 50002, 'NO NEXT BUSINESS DATE RETRIEVED FROM EDS.DATE_DIM, OM.OM_TASK_RUN AND EDS.EDS_CTL TABLE', 1; 
			END
			
		UPDATE [EDS].[EDS_CTL] SET LOANS_DATE=@NEXT_PROCESS_DATE
	
	END
GO
